info.title: IITK Lost & Found API
info.description: Report, find, claim and return lost items through campus security offices.

post.description:
Step 1: email a 6-digit code. In development it's printed in the
terminal running the API.

Step 2: check the code. On success, set the session cookie and
return the user. If `is_onboarded` is false, show the onboarding form next.

get.description: Who is signed in? 401 if nobody.

post.description:
Sign out: delete the session in the database and remove the cookie.
Safe to call even when not signed in.
First-time profile. Name and roll number can't be changed afterwards.

patch.description: Change phone, hall or room. Send only the fields you want to change.

get.description: The Found page (kind=FOUND) or the Lost page (kind=LOST).

The Returned Items page, most recent return first. Staff also get
who collected each item and who handed it over. Records are deleted
60 days after the return.
Everything I've reported, in any status.

post.description: The item stays hidden from the Found page until a guard receives it.

put.description:
The reporter corrects their report (name, category, colour, brand,
description, place, date). Send all fields, as in the report form.
Allowed while a lost report is open, or a found item isn't handed in yet.

delete.description: The finder withdraws a found report they haven't handed in yet.

get.description:
"Similar items found": found items that may match a lost report, or
lost reports that may match a found item. Only for the person who
reported the item, and staff. The ranking comes from the matcher
(services/matching.py); with the placeholder it is always empty.

put.description: The finder picks a different office to hand the item in at (before hand-in).

post.description: Close my lost report: RECOVERED (got it back) or CLOSED (stopped looking).
Add one photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP). Call once per photo.

delete.description: Remove a photo (e.g. to replace it with a better one).

get.description:
Photos are served through the API (not as public files), so the same
"who may see this item" rule applies to its photos.

Found items for the staff desk.
waiting = reported, not yet handed in; held = at an office; closed = returned, disposed or donated.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Words, or a reference like FND-0031
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Words, or a reference like FND-0031

post.description: Register an item someone handed in without an online report.
Mark an unclaimed item as DISPOSED or DONATED. A note is required.

"This is mine": start a claim on a found item held at an office.
`details` (up to 5) are separate identifying details a guard will check.

get.description: Only the claimant and staff can open a claim; for others it's 404.

post.description: Add one proof image (max 3), before a guard starts reviewing.

get.description: Proof images are private: only the claimant and staff can open them.

post.description:
The proof isn't enough: ask the claimant to come to the office. The
note tells them what to bring or explain.
After the office visit: write down what the claimant showed or said.
A reason is required: the claimant is told why.

The approved claimant is at the desk and their ID card matches their
name and roll number. The return time is taken from the server clock.

put.description:
Record whether one identifying detail matches the item (MATCH /
NO_MATCH), or clear the check (null). Only while under review.

post.description: Record a detail the claimant told a guard in person, with its verdict.

get.description: Every guard and admin, admins first.

schema.title: Response List Staff Admin Staff Get

post.description: Make someone a guard or an admin (creates the account if they've never signed in).

patch.description: Change role (guard <-> admin) and/or usual office. Not your own role.

delete.description: Turn a guard or admin back into a student. Takes effect immediately. Not yourself.

ClaimItemBrief.title: ClaimItemBrief
ClaimItemBrief.description: The item being claimed, as the claim page shows it.

ClaimRowOut.title: ClaimRowOut
ClaimRowOut.description: One line in a list of claims.

DeskDetailIn.title: DeskDetailIn
DeskDetailIn.description:
A detail the claimant told a guard in person (office visit), recorded
with the guard's verdict straight away (FR-CUS-06).

DetailVerdictIn.title: DetailVerdictIn
DetailVerdictIn.description: A guard's check of one detail. null clears a mistaken check.

ItemCardOut.title: ItemCardOut
ItemCardOut.description:
What the Found and Lost pages show for each item. Deliberately
contains nothing about who reported it.

ItemClaimRow.title: ItemClaimRow
ItemClaimRow.description: For staff: every claim on this item.

ItemPage.title: ItemPage
ItemPage.description: One page of results, plus what the frontend needs to draw page links.

MyClaimBrief.title: MyClaimBrief
MyClaimBrief.description: My latest claim on this item, so the item page can link to it.

PersonBrief.title: PersonBrief
PersonBrief.description: Who reported an item. Only ever sent to staff.

ProfileUpdateIn.title: ProfileUpdateIn
ProfileUpdateIn.description:
Only phone, hall and room. Name and roll number are deliberately
missing: after onboarding they're locked.

RequiredNoteIn.title: RequiredNoteIn
RequiredNoteIn.description:
For decisions the claimant must understand: a rejection reason, what
to bring to the office, what they explained in person.

ReturnedStaffOut.title: ReturnedStaffOut
ReturnedStaffOut.description: Only sent to staff: who got the item back, and who handed it over.

ScoreOut.title: ScoreOut
ScoreOut.description:
C = 50M + 20R + 30H (staff only). Advisory: it orders the review
queue and never decides ownership (FR-SCORE-04).

StaffItemOut.title: StaffItemOut
StaffItemOut.description: A row on the staff desk: the public card plus what staff need.

StaffUpdateIn.title: StaffUpdateIn
StaffUpdateIn.description:
Send only what changes: {"role": "ADMIN"}, {"office_id": 3}, or both.
{"office_id": null} clears the usual office.

UserOut.title: UserOut
UserOut.description:
What the API returns about a user. Fields not listed here are
never sent, even if the database row has them.

WalkInIn.title: WalkInIn
WalkInIn.description: A guard registering an item someone handed in without an online report.
